OCR_NUMERIC_DISAGREEMENT.message: Multiple observations for the same logical numeric cell disagree materially.
OCR_NUMERIC_DISAGREEMENT.detection: Aligned observations parse as different exact numeric values.

TEXT_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT.message: Text observations for one logical token conflict without a trusted resolution rule.
TEXT_OBSERVATION_CONFLICT.detection: Aligned normalized text differs and no qualified native/OCR rule resolves it.

TEXT_CONFUSABLE_DISAGREEMENT.message: OCR differs only by qualified confusable characters from strong native text.
TEXT_CONFUSABLE_DISAGREEMENT.detection: Strong native text and OCR normalize to a configured confusable-equivalent token.

PDF_TEXT_MAPPING_CORRUPT.message: Native PDF text mapping is explicitly qualified as corrupt; unanimous OCR is selected.
PDF_TEXT_MAPPING_CORRUPT.detection: NativeTextQuality is mapping_corrupt and aligned OCR observations agree.

TABLE_CELL_PASS_MISSING.message: A required extraction pass has no observation for an aligned logical cell.
TABLE_CELL_PASS_MISSING.detection: Exact row/column alignment finds a missing required pass cell.

TABLE_PAGE_SURFACE_REQUIRED.message: Governed table extraction requires an explicit page-bearing source surface.
TABLE_PAGE_SURFACE_REQUIRED.detection: Table pass input lacks pageNumber on its bound source surface.

PROVIDER_PIXEL_CONVENTION_UNKNOWN.message: Provider geometry coordinate convention is unknown.
PROVIDER_PIXEL_CONVENTION_UNKNOWN.detection: Provider profile reports unknown or undeclared pixel convention for geometry-bearing output.

OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_SURFACE_REQUIRED.message: Provider geometry is present without an explicit provider surface.
OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_SURFACE_REQUIRED.detection: Observation contains providerGeometry but no provider surface identity.

OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_PROFILE_CONFLICT.message: Observation provider identity conflicts with its supplied provider profile.
OBSERVATION_PROVIDER_PROFILE_CONFLICT.detection: Observation role/provider/version or explicit profile hash differs from ProviderProfile.v1.

NATIVE_QUALITY_PROFILE_CONFLICT.message: Native text quality assessment is not bound to the observation provider profile.
NATIVE_QUALITY_PROFILE_CONFLICT.detection: NativeTextQuality assessmentProfileHash differs from observation providerProfileHash.

NATIVE_QUALITY_HASH_INVALID.message: Native text quality content does not match its claimed hash.
NATIVE_QUALITY_HASH_INVALID.detection: Recomputed canonical NativeTextQuality hash differs from nativeQualityHash.

DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.message: DOCX rendered-page evidence lacks required renderer, environment, font, or display-policy identity.
DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_INCOMPLETE.detection: RenderProfile.v1 for documentKind=docx omits a required reproducibility field.

DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_CHANGED.message: DOCX semantic source is unchanged but rendered-page profile identity changed.
DOCX_RENDER_PROFILE_CHANGED.detection: Source semantic hash matches while renderProfileHash differs.

TRANSFORM_NONINVERTIBLE.message: Surface transform is singular and cannot be inverted.
TRANSFORM_NONINVERTIBLE.detection: Affine determinant is zero or below the numerical singularity gate.

TRANSFORM_ROUNDTRIP_FAILED.message: Surface transform exceeds the declared continuous round-trip tolerance.
TRANSFORM_ROUNDTRIP_FAILED.detection: Deterministic fiducial forward/inverse error exceeds the contract gate.

OVERLAY_STALE_SOURCE.message: Overlay source hash does not match the current document source.
OVERLAY_STALE_SOURCE.detection: Overlay sourceHash differs from active source identity.

OVERLAY_STALE_TRANSFORM.message: Overlay transform hash does not match the current surface transform.
OVERLAY_STALE_TRANSFORM.detection: Overlay surfaceTransformHash differs from the active transform identity.

EVIDENCE_HASH_INVALID.message: Canonical evidence content does not match its claimed hash.
EVIDENCE_HASH_INVALID.detection: Recomputed canonical hash differs from the stored evidence hash.

DOCX_RENDER_NONDETERMINISTIC.message: DOCX rendered surface changed under the same semantic content and render profile.
DOCX_RENDER_NONDETERMINISTIC.detection: semanticContentHash and renderProfileHash match while surfaceHash differs.

DOCX_SEMANTIC_CONTENT_CHANGED.detection: Canonical meaningful OOXML/media content differs after volatile package/editing noise is removed.

DOCX_SEMANTIC_VISUAL_AMBIGUOUS.message: DOCX semantic node cannot be mapped uniquely to the rendered surface.
DOCX_SEMANTIC_VISUAL_AMBIGUOUS.detection: Semantic-to-visual mapping status is ambiguous or non-unique.

DOCX_FONT_SUBSTITUTION.message: DOCX renderer substituted a requested font.
DOCX_FONT_SUBSTITUTION.detection: Resolved font manifest contains at least one substituted font entry.

DOCX_FONT_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.message: Render profile font-manifest identity does not match resolved font evidence.
DOCX_FONT_MANIFEST_MISMATCH.detection: renderProfile.fontManifestHash differs from the computed ResolvedFontManifest hash.

OCR_RESOURCE_LIMIT.message: OCR attempt or job exceeds a hard resource policy limit.
OCR_RESOURCE_LIMIT.detection: Page/region count, pixels, dimension, calls, memory, wall time or persisted output exceeds OcrResourcePolicy.v1.

OCR_REGION_INVALID.message: OCR crop region lies outside its source surface or has invalid dimensions.
OCR_REGION_INVALID.detection: Crop validation fails before raster/OCR execution.

PREPROCESSING_SURFACE_DISCONTINUITY.message: Preprocessing transforms do not form a continuous surface chain.
PREPROCESSING_SURFACE_DISCONTINUITY.detection: One transform targetSurfaceId differs from the next sourceSurfaceId.

GEOMETRY_CTM_INVALID.message: Provider geometry effective CTM is malformed.
GEOMETRY_CTM_INVALID.detection: Geometry evidence CTM is neither six affine values nor nine homogeneous values.

GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_UNBOUND.message: Geometry evidence references a source or surface outside its machine-evidence envelope.
GEOMETRY_EVIDENCE_UNBOUND.detection: GeometryEvidence sourceHash/surfaceId is absent or mismatched in the envelope.

TRANSFORM_SURFACE_UNBOUND.message: Surface transform references a surface outside its machine-evidence envelope.
TRANSFORM_SURFACE_UNBOUND.detection: sourceSurfaceId or targetSurfaceId is absent from envelope surfaces.

DECISION_OBSERVATION_UNBOUND.message: Evidence decision references an observation outside its machine-evidence envelope.
DECISION_OBSERVATION_UNBOUND.detection: decision.observationHashes is not a subset of envelope observation hashes.

EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_FUTURE_MAJOR.message: Evidence artifact schema major is newer than the reader supports.
EVIDENCE_SCHEMA_FUTURE_MAJOR.detection: artifact schema major is greater than reader schema major.

EVIDENCE_LEGACY_ADAPTER_REQUIRED.message: Legacy evidence requires an explicit versioned adapter before trusted use.
EVIDENCE_LEGACY_ADAPTER_REQUIRED.detection: artifact schema major is older than the reader and no lossless adapter has been applied.

CORRECTION_APPROVAL_CONFLICT.message: Multiple terminal approved corrections target one immutable observation.
CORRECTION_APPROVAL_CONFLICT.detection: Approved correction graph has more than one non-superseded terminal event.

CORRECTION_TARGET_MISMATCH.message: Correction event targets a different immutable observation than the requested effective view.
CORRECTION_TARGET_MISMATCH.detection: targetObservationHash differs from the effective-view observation hash.

OVERLAY_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED.message: Overlay lacks an authoritative surface transform identity.
OVERLAY_TRANSFORM_REQUIRED.detection: overlay creation is attempted without surfaceTransformHash.

PROVIDER_COORDINATE_NONCONFORMANT.message: Geometry-bearing provider does not declare a portable coordinate convention.
PROVIDER_COORDINATE_NONCONFORMANT.detection: ProviderProfile for OCR or PDF geometry omits coordinateConvention or cannot satisfy the normalized coordinate contract.

PROVIDER_REPRODUCIBILITY_INCOMPLETE.message: Provider profile lacks enough pinned identity to support reproducible evidence use.
PROVIDER_REPRODUCIBILITY_INCOMPLETE.detection: OCR provider declares neither model identity nor provider binary hash.

PROVIDER_CONFORMANCE_FAILED.message: Provider evidence is missing required identity or determinism fields.
PROVIDER_CONFORMANCE_FAILED.detection: Provider profile or observation fails the normative conformance identity checks.

EVIDENCE_SOURCE_CONFLICT.message: Evidence selected for comparison or reconciliation is bound to different immutable sources.
EVIDENCE_SOURCE_CONFLICT.detection: Compared observations or provider outputs have different sourceHash values.

EVIDENCE_STORAGE_POLICY_INCOMPLETE.message: Persistent evidence storage lacks required retention, access, eviction, or capacity policy.
EVIDENCE_STORAGE_POLICY_INCOMPLETE.detection: Persistent mode omits TTL, retained-byte cap, non-job access scope, or persistent eviction policy.

EVIDENCE_STORAGE_NOT_PERSISTENT.message: Persistent evidence retrieval was requested for an ephemeral storage policy.
EVIDENCE_STORAGE_NOT_PERSISTENT.detection: Retrieval eligibility is requested while storage mode is ephemeral.
